zones.title: MCP server
zones.body: Bearer-protected MCP trigger at /mcp/ar-proof-tools. The tools are the demo sub-workflows plus ConfirmSlot (the CONFIRM step as a tool); RequestAgent is the REFER path.

panels.title: AR-52 MCP tool server
panels.body: The Realtime API executes MCP tools itself, so the tools are the sub-workflows behind a bearer-protected MCP trigger. The session id travels in the instructions and comes back as a tool argument.
